5646.html:
5646 táthā 'so, in that way' RV., 'so also' Mn. [tá-]
    Pa. tathā 'thus', Aś. tathā̆, NiDoc. tatha, taha, daha, Pk. tadhā, tahā̆, tahi (variation -i ~ -a orig. IA. cf. Pk. ia ~ iti, utá ~ Lat. utī J. Przyluski RHA 1936, 200: very doubtful); Gy. wel. thā 'and', gr. ta, Ḍ. ta; Ash. tə 'and, or'; Paš.lauṛ. thā 'then'; K. ta 'and'; L. tā̃h, tā̃ 'so, indeed, then'.
    tathya-; tathāpi.

11183.html:
11183 vaḥ enclitic 2 pl. pronoun.
    Pa. vō, vē, Aś. ve dat., Ash. Wg. wī, iwī nom., Dm. bi, Shum. wī (~ acc. ima < yuṣmā́n), Kho. bisa, pisa < *vsa (→ Wkh. sav 'of you' Rep¹ 80): discussion of Kaf. and Dard. forms by G. Morgenstierne IL v 361. — See yuṣmad-.
    vakula- see bakula-.
